messages:
Rina: Quick thread  We're coordinating a joint GTM with CloudPartner + SI (integration tested on CloudPartner Marketplace). Need to land the marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure) and align on the joint announcement embargo. Owners needed: partner logo approval, co-marketing blurb, SKU packaging, legal signoff, infra proof-of-deployment. Target: request staging & coordinated announce in 3 weeks. Who can take what?
Owen: I can take co-marketing & announcement timing. Will sync with partner comms and confirm embargo. We should propose a "soft announce" to partners 48h before public.
Carlos: I'll own SKU packaging and the listing feature bullets. Plan: 2 SKUs (starter, enterprise-trial with 30d). I'll draft SKU IDs and a short README for pricing and trial gating.
Diego: Legal here  I'll review partner logo license, press embargo language, and the privacy/retention blurb. Need partner contract snippet and any third-party model notices. Aim for signoff in 4 business days.
Mei: Eng note: will validate the deployment samples used in the listing (we tested on CloudPartner infra) and prepare minimal publisher IAM snippets for each cloud. Will also add a short note about supported GPU families (A10G, A100).
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: New checklist added: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checklists/joint-g2m-marketplace.md (rev 2025-02-02)
Rina: Two additional asks: 1) Partner requires the "co-branded tile" and approved hero image before the embargo; 2) SI wants a short integration note (1-2 lines) on the listing stating the SI provides deployment automation.
Owen: I'll get logo approval & hero copy from partner. Also will request a short quote we can use in the listing (if partner agrees).
Carlos: Packaging draft note: include a "Deploy with SI" badge and a small section: "Includes deployment recipe with [SI Name] for one-click provisioning." Also will include a data residency toggle in the SKU description.
Diego: Add a dedicated checkbox in the manifest for "partner legal OK" + "press embargo approved". I'll add language for attribution and model-licensing if any third-party models are referenced.
Mei: IAM snippet (AWS) to include in publisher manifest for cross-account role:
```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodPublisher"}, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole" }] }
```
Rina: Action items recap:
- Owen: partner logo & approved hero + embargo timing (3bd)
- Carlos: SKU list + packaging README (48h)
- Mei: publisher IAM snippets + supported HW note (48h)
- Diego: legal manifest + partner license checkboxes (4bd)
marketplace-bot: :warning: Compliance requirement: upload partner_logo_license.pdf and signed privacy_manifest.pdf before staging request.
Owen: Can we aim for a prep review call next Tue 9:00am PT to walk the listing + co-marketing assets with the partner?
Carlos: Works for me.
Diego: I'll attend.
Mei: I'll join as well.
Rina: Thanks all  I'll send the invite and the shared folder link (/Shared/marketplace/joint-g2m/1745001234). Will also include the partner contact card.
Owen: FYI partner asked that we don't publish pricing details in advance; keep pricing behind the listing CTA and use "Contact sales" for pro-tier.
Carlos: Noted. We'll keep public bullets generic and reserve specific tiers behind the CTA.
Rina: Great. Moving forward  I'll ping here when the folder is ready and when the partner confirms the hero image.
